purpose: Owner-directed O:I-world participation refinement within the existing O-I#65 C0–C5 campaign and #220 integration. Projectable Workcells, agents and practices join knowledge, live activity and authored Beings/Things; no new story family, runtime or capability registry.
standing: Owner-directed intended experience and implementation/testing commission, 28 September 2026. Completed #18 carrier evidence is retained; this module claims no installed or human acceptance.
source_reading_note: campaign.json imports this module. The existing compiler hashes the module, story_source and document_operations_source. Other linked sources and actual native matrix digests must be resolved at C0; linked filenames are not evidence of execution or recursive hashing.

obligations.native_locator: SHARED-FIELD-DESKTOP sections 0, 2, 3, 7 and 18.2; Personal Web #279; #18 naming amendment 5718300149
obligations.requirement: People share a coherent region of their O:I world and participate in artificial-plus-human agency: eligible Workcells, agents/repertoires, Skills/Methods, projects, knowledge and activity become independently inspectable through Beings/Things and the existing Projection contracts.
required_branches: Project one actual Workcell description/offer, one Agent and its practice, a source-backed project/knowledge constellation, authored HTML and meaningful current activity; another authorised World resolves each source identity and outward revision.

Typed constituent relations explain the working World. Being/Thing is presentation, declared availability differs from observed current occurrence, and publication differs from offered or granted operation.

Partial compositions share their actual useful field. Audience filtering covers content, assets, embedded data, relation expansion, metadata and counts without publishing adjacent private configuration.

obligations.native_locator: SHARED-FIELD-DESKTOP sections 1–4, 8, 12, 15–18; O-I#375 and current desktop consumer
obligations.requirement: Ordinary Explore entry opens an explorable shared world whose knowledge constellation, agent-act Expression and authored Beings/Things are complementary presentations of the same native subjects.
required_branches: Use the actual installed rail/button and keyboard entry: search, bounded graph, Being/Thing, native source, knowledge/activity Expression, back/forward and local Workspace restoration. Each visible operation has an actual owner effect/readback.
Different Worlds with the same labels remain distinguishable; live, static and replay availability are shown; narrow and reduced-motion use remains operable.

Selected activity remains the primary material, with participant/source/repertoire depth opened contextually. Real node/entity selection, source actions, renderer lifecycle and interactive assets replace no-op or metadata-only surfaces.

obligations.native_locator: SHARED-FIELD-DESKTOP sections 2 and 8; AIKit#142; QL-MEF#83 operative syntax
obligations.requirement: The existing AIKit Resolve/Search and Śiva–Śakti-derived syntax resolve shared subjects, practices, participating worlds and activity through one typed reference field.
required_branches: Human normal-language search and structured Agent resolution co-refer to exact source/subject/presentation/Projection/field occurrences; World/SharedField scope survives resolution and traversal.

The six address horizons and relation operators change the actual resolution request. Use the current native parser/AST and Explain/History; general O:I works without QL and the full QL binding is separately proven when selected.

Exact/ref/fuzzy discovery remains useful without optional deep providers. Wrong-world/same-label, private-neighbour, stale-index and revoked-cache cases preserve eligible scope and declare incomplete coverage. Resolving an Action is not executing it.

obligations.native_locator: SHARED-FIELD-DESKTOP sections 4–6 and 9; O-I#154; AIKit#275; Workcell#72
obligations.requirement: A participant brings a real Agent into a shared NOW, the actual body receives relevant shared context and performs useful work, and messages can address the field, a durable responsibility or a precise instance at its Workcell.
required_branches: Observe membership, selected Agent/Agency/AgentSession or occupancy generation, prepared and delivered field context, actual material binding, substantive work and attributed response/Contribution separately.

Field/Position addressing follows declared routing; exact-instance plus required-Workcell targeting cannot silently select a successor, local-first substitute or same-named remote peer. Exercise replacement, duplicate/out-of-order delivery and unavailable recipient.

Joining from the participant's existing Workcell differs from deliberate relocation. Communique, Contribution, delegation and Factory developmental custody retain their actual effects; a personal/shared conversation need not become a Run.

obligations.native_locator: SHARED-FIELD-DESKTOP sections 0.1, 9–13; current RunExpressionBody and native activity/Expression owners
obligations.requirement: Local and shared activity Expressions make actual human-and-agent work inspectable in live, frozen and replay readings, with knowledge and authored pages connected to its cast, work and results.
required_branches: A genuine developmental Run uses the current Factory Expression; other activity uses its own native lineage. Actual owner events and artifacts drive the presented cast, purpose, communication, work and Return.
Disconnect or freeze the owner producer and verify liveness degrades rather than being synthesised by the renderer. Compare local and hosted views of the same activity refs and revisions.

Retain a frozen edition and supported event/scene/artifact replay with its source and asset basis. Replay has no historical tool side effects; a live continuation or re-execution is a separate admitted operation.

obligations.native_locator: SHARED-FIELD-DESKTOP sections 6, 7, 18.1 and 18.2; existing Wiki/constellation and praxis Return
obligations.requirement: Shared participation leaves a useful artifact, knowledge or practice which returns through its native owner, is encounterable in the field and helps later work in another participant's world.
required_branches: Develop and review a substantive source-backed Expression/knowledge refinement, apply through actual native source/Wiki/Expression operations, and reproject the resulting revision with contribution lineage.

Inspect a shared Skill/Method, explicitly adopt/adapt it locally or invoke an offered capability, then use it in a real task. Retain original identity/version and intentional local differences; publication alone is not trust or execution.

Exercise correction and stale source/Projection bases. A fresh participant uses the changed knowledge/practice on a related but different input; saved lesson, ack or summary alone is insufficient uptake.

obligations.requirement: One grounded world across Workcells and independently authorised shared worlds remain usable through time, disconnection, revocation and fresh-body re-entry, with shared and local state correctly related.
required_branches: On Mac and Omarchy, test first one World with two actual root NOW/Workcell horizons and then separately authorised test Worlds with distinct source roots and participants. Two windows with one credential do not prove independent participant boundaries.
Reconcile shared Central/root and meta-Workcell composition, regional shared NOWs, FieldNow/FieldDay and exact execution location without replacing local source or personal Day identity.

Exercise source-offline hosting, service/gateway interruption, duplicate/late output, source changes, withdrawal/cache invalidation, body replacement and optional Shared Stage follow/unfollow. Preserve drafts, ongoing local work, current target and exact occurrence/receipt lineage.

obligations.native_locator: SHARED-FIELD-DESKTOP section 18.1; TOOLS.md native capability binding; Central CAPABILITY-MATRIX-PROTOCOL
obligations.requirement: Development and testing are anchored in reviewed native capability matrices, full UX obligations and real operation/praxis/source evidence, with improvements returned into that same field.
required_branches: At C0 bind each required branch to repository-qualified native capability IDs, exact matrix digests and account units, current public operations and practice/provider/authority/material conditions using the existing --matrix and --bindings path.

Required but absent capability or unsupported operation is an explicit owner implementation packet, not dropped scope or fabricated evidence. Retain complete selected QL trace/deeper matrices where used; ordinary SharedField remains usable without QL.

Executable tests enter existing scenario-bindings/native suites and retain failed episodes. The verifier holds source-derived expectations and disconnected/wrong-target controls; actors receive meaningful situated work and normal discoverable powers. Repair, replay and update warranted native matrix/Wiki/Skill/code/test links, then verify later use.
